Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment (ChIP-SICAP) specifically compares the AR chromatome in VCaP cells treated with the synthetic androgen R1881 versus a vehicle control. While the paper also describes genetic perturbations (SMARCA4 and SIM2 depletion) and other assays (RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq), these were used for functional validation and are not the primary variables of the mass spectrometry dataset described in the PRIDE metadata and methods.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment explicitly uses SILAC-labeled VCaP cells (heavy: Arg10, Lys8; light: Arg0, Lys0) and data-dependent acquisition (DDA) on an Orbitrap Fusion.

workflow: SILAC-labeled VCaP cells (9 × 106 cells/ 15-cm culture dish, Supplementary materials) were cultured for 72 h, before adding 10 nM R1881 to heavy-labeled (Arg10, Lys8) cells and ethanol (vehicle) to light-labeled (Arg0, Lys0) cells
Peptides were analyzed on a Tri-Hybrid Orbitrap Fusion mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) operated in positive (+2kV) data dependent acquisition mode with HCD fragmentation.
differential: R1881-induced chromatin protein network of AR was discriminated from total ChIP-SICAP data with moderated t-statistics with linear model analysis (limma ref (22)) in R by using adjusted p-value < 0.05 and LogFC (R1881/EtOH) > 0 as cut-off values.
Only a master protein of MS identified protein groups was used for visualization purposes.
search_parameters: Methionine oxidation and N-terminal acetylation were set as variable modifications, while carbamidomethylation of cysteine residues was set as fixed modification.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The experiment uses ChIP-SICAP, a specialized affinity purification method to isolate chromatin-bound proteins, but the MS analysis follows a standard SILAC DDA bottom-up proteomics workflow.
